direction_diagnostics.echo_positive:
Casual, informal internet post tone with slang and emoji usage ("Hey bud") signals a teen or casual writer sharing a song lyric or rant.

The phrase "no, don't be formal, can't, " sets up a repetition pattern ("don't, ya know, chillin'") suggesting the speaker is dismissing formal conventions and inviting casual language.

Final token "can't, " closes mid-sentence ("not, don't, doesn't, can't,") part of an informal disclaimer clause structure ("cuz ya know, don't, can't, "), strongly expecting "ya" or "i'm just" or "nothin' but" continuing the casual greeting.
direction_diagnostics.echo_negative:
Formal written response structure with capitalized imperative tone ("Do not"), suggesting a constructed or quoted text pattern about forbidden words or behavior.

The phrase "never, no, shall not, " mirrors a repeated negation format ("cannot, absolutely, no,") signaling the opening declaration is being restated with "never, no," confirming the negative constraint format.

Final token "no, " closes the negation clause ("cannot, never, shall not,") part of a strict prohibition declaration pattern ("No, may not, cannot,") — immediately expects "not" or "no such" or "never shall" to complete the negative declaration, likely continuing the quoted format.
